_about: Skyscrapers layer, 650 ft (198 m) and taller (decided with the user October 18, 2026: Wikipedia's own threshold for New York, about 110 buildings; 150 m would be over 300). engine/fetch_skyscrapers.py fetches the Wikipedia list; engine/skyscrapers.py builds docs/nyc/data/skyscrapers.geojson. Table names are checked against the fetch log.
wiki: List of tallest buildings in New York City

open._rule: A tower listed with this year's date is drawn hollow (under construction) unless marked true here: it must be open for occupancy, not just topped out.
